ticks.reading: the figures above are the closure's reading of the run log at the instant of the snapshot; later scheduled ticks are on disk and are not counted here

data.finished_days_re_derived: 2026-10-13 and 2026-10-14 were re-derived from the store by the tick of 2026-10-15T15:16:35Z, after the independent verifier refused the partial-day hashes their own files carried
data.point_in_time: only bars that had closed at the tick's own market instant are requested; a bar still open is not fetched, not counted and not claimed
data.latency_rule: close to store, measured per bar this tick pulled; a bar counts forward only if it arrived within 30 min (15m) or 2 h (1h) of closing

measured_fresh_latency_seconds.reading: the large figures are the bars recovered after a disk block, arriving hours late; they are labelled, not smoothed into the fresh ones

ruleset.checked_on_every_tick: forward_plan.assert_frozen_params() runs first; a moved ruleset is VERIFICATION_FAILED (exit 6), never a warning

strategies_evaluated.reading: each arm is re-read over the whole forward window on every tick; the figures are hypothetical, and no arm is ranked, chosen or promoted here

decisions.reading: a decision is a hypothetical signal under the frozen ruleset; a refusal is a decision the ruleset declined to take. Both are evidence; neither is an order

hypothetical_economics.reading: hypothetical only: these are the frozen ruleset's numbers over the forward window with costs and slippage applied, not a realised result and not an expectation of one

risk_engine_parity.reading: the research budget is compared with the real Risk Engine's own decisions on the same inputs; a difference is named, never smoothed

errors.reason: holder pid 35104 is live and renewed
holder pid 1308 is live and renewed

alerts.one_row_per_transition: alerts fire on a transition, never per tick: one DISK_CRITICAL covers the whole 45-tick refusal episode
alerts.no_order_or_promotion_alert: no alert in the vocabulary can place an order or promote anything

publication.namespace: each published file is keyed by its own path relative to the publication root, with its size, its digest, the role it was written under and whether this render wrote it
publication.why_the_namespace_changed: the pointer used to name only what the newest render wrote, while the swap leaves every earlier per-date report in place because a published report is never deleted; the independent verifier refused it for describing a subset while reading as complete, so the pointer now enumerates the directory and the check became name-for-name
publication.cadence: once per 24 h, not per tick; every later tick records 'the publication cadence has not elapsed'. One render was forced in this session because the pointer's vocabulary had changed, and the tick record says so

offline_reproduction.cumulative_difference: one line: 'Ledger rows on file: 228' now against '12' as published. write_observability() counts the ingest ledger's rows on disk at the path the payload names, so that line is a live reading rather than a function of the preserved payload. Three of four reproduce byte for byte; the property holds but it expires, and it is reported rather than claimed away

failed_then_fixed: DAILY_EVIDENCE_CONSISTENT: two day files whose hashes were taken while their own day was still running, and which could therefore never answer to the store (this session)
PUBLICATION_SWAPPED_ATOMICALLY: two published day reports the pointer did not name, because it enumerated the newest render rather than the directory (this session)
DAILY_EVIDENCE_CONSISTENT: a day file that let a repeat trigger overwrite an interval's numbers (first session)
BUDGET_DECLARED_MEASURED_AND_BOUNDED: a byte reading taken before the tick's own row existed (first session)
ARTIFACTS_PRESENT / BUDGET: a snapshot that copied a curated subset rather than the whole state root (first session)
independent_verification.self_test_blind_spot_found: the 'grow a bounded log past its cap' sabotage was caught only as a side effect of a byte comparison; the cap arm itself compared names the bundle never loads. Both were repaired

rerun_on_the_committed_snapshot.reading: the committed snapshot re-derives the published verdict rather than merely being described by it
rerun_on_the_committed_snapshot.expiry: the day-hash arm is exact for ever for a finished day and exact only at the snapshot instant for the day the store is still filling, because a running day file is refreshed by every tick; re-take the snapshot with scripts/edge04_closure.py rather than re-verify a stale copy

first_verdict_of_this_session.reading: the verifier refused the live lane, on two artefacts at once, before it accepted it; both refusals were correct and both causes were fixed

forecast.reading: a forecast is published only when the measured rate is stable; otherwise it is null, because an invented number is worse than no number

resources.forecast_rule: a forecast is published only when the measured rate is stable; an invented number is worse than no number
resources.disk_refusal_window: 2026-10-13T20:25:56Z to 2026-10-14T13:40:56Z, with the volume at 1.81 GiB free (99.24 % used), below the declared 2 GiB critical floor; no market request was made and no slot was consumed

forward_coverage.near_misses_reported_as_misses: 2026-10-13 reached 58.3 % and 2026-10-14 reached 79.2 %; the floor is 90 % and the rule has no rounding, so both are misses
forward_coverage.why: the volume sat below its critical floor for ~17 hours and the host was asleep for much of the rest; the continuity record names both instead of reporting one uptime figure
forward_coverage.rule: a day counts only if every primary asset holds at least 90% of the bars the calendar expects and those bars reached the store while still fresh (30 min for 15m, 2 h for 1h)
forward_coverage.reading: zero, and zero is correct: the frozen corpora cover history, a day on which the scheduler ran is not a forward day, and a day at 79 % coverage is not a day at 90 %
forward_coverage.not_an_admission: reaching the floor makes a later decision possible; it does not make it, and this lane cannot promote a strategy

session_findings.what_was_run: the closure was re-run over the live state three days on, and the independent verifier refused the lane before it accepted it

refusals.detail: daily/2026-10-13.json: 15m:BTC digest does not answer to the store, and the same for the other five series
refusals.cause: a day file is written by the ticks of its own day, so its last write of that day cannot hold the day's last bars; the published hashes described a partial day for ever
refusals.fix: a tick now re-derives and corrects the hashes of a finished day whose file disagrees with the store, and records the correction; the next tick corrected 2026-10-13 and 2026-10-14, six series each

refusals.detail: 15 published file(s) against 13 recorded digest(s); a published file answers to no recorded digest: DAILY_2026-10-13.md; DAILY_2026-10-14.md
refusals.cause: the pointer enumerated the newest render, while the swap never deletes a published report and therefore leaves earlier per-date reports in place
refusals.fix: the pointer enumerates the directory, keyed by relative path, with role and origin; the check is name-for-name and 15 files are named and answered

hardening.finding: the snapshot is written into a directory that already holds one, and nothing dropped a file the live tree no longer had, so the copy could be the union of two readings while claiming to be one
hardening.evidence: the evidence directory held a copy of a published file at 136444 bytes where the live tree had 136989
hardening.fix: exactly the files the previous SNAPSHOT.json recorded are dropped when the live tree has lost them, and the snapshot names what it dropped; all 29 live files are now byte-identical in evidence/
